svg.title: Separate lanes touch only the directory
svg.desc: Use several separately bounded lanes as a schematic sample, all touching only the cache. Let the caption carry the measured population and message counts; icon count is not a substitute census.

**Frame:** Wide view of many isolated workload lanes touching the same central directory tree. No line directly joins any pair.

**Action:** The board becomes population-scale shared state.
